deadline_contract: 10-second monotonic deadline checked before/after metadata reads and each enumerated entry; not an unconditional scheduling/I/O latency guarantee. The reader request itself has a separate 30-second tool limit.
held_path_and_IO_contract: Every fixed jobs path component opened directory/no-follow; final owner UID1000
Only hex-pattern job directory names are opened; request.json regular UID1000 nlink1 no-follow/nonblocking, bounded and held/named identity rechecked
Only exact original execution tuple plus job_id/job_dir/stdin_path/digest metadata match permits fixed stdin.bin read
Every matching stdin must equal 35263 bytes and external SHA; unmatched argv/env/stdin/job IDs are not output
Every job/file/directory FD is closed in finally; collection errors and counts are retained without disclosing other-job data

local_controls.scope: Local exact parser/observed suffix shapes plus two owned temporary files; no real jobs root/main/ordinary execution

local_freeze_first_attempt: An AST-only check used literal_eval on a multiplication expression and failed before writing bundle payloads; corrected by comparing its exact BinOp AST. No source or remote behavior changed.
numeric_field_contract: Only exact numerical equality accepts int/float JSON representation of integral resource values; booleans, changed values, rounded values and nonnumeric strings reject
output_contract: At most eight matching tuples and 64KiB JSON. Exact match only after request plus held stdin and directory proof. Zero exact matches is NOT_FOUND_AT_OBSERVATION, even if collection was incomplete; no inference original call was invalid, no replay.
production_AST_checks: No exec/eval/compile/dynamic import, subprocess or socket module

revision02.sole_production_change: JOB_ID final hex segment accepts 1..4 characters
revision02.specific_predecessor_defect: Four-hex-only suffix would reject 523 observed jobs and keep collection_complete false

scope: Single fixed UID1000 read-only job metadata reconciliation; no ordinary tests, writes, namespace, task dispatch or Main action
